seo.description_paragraph: Arbuckle is an Anglo-Saxon name with a rich history and deep significance in Christianity. Derived from the Old English words ‘eoran’ (earth) and ‘bucc’ (spear), Arbuckle signifies a bold warrior or protector. In Christian belief, this name represents strength and resilience, making it an excellent choice for a son. The name Arbuckle has seen a resurgence in popularity in recent years, reflecting the enduring appeal of its powerful meaning and connection to the earth.
